title: Three's Chances
description: Three hardcore chances with auto-respawn, configurable health per life, and a permanent final state when all lives are gone.
body:
Three’s Chances reworks Hardcore into a limited-lives system instead of a single permanent death.

How it works
- Players have a configurable number of lives.
- In Hardcore mode, deaths before the final life are intercepted and converted into an instant - auto-respawn.
- Maximum health can differ for each life (e.g., 20 → 18 → 15).
- On the final life, the mod applies a permanent outcome: spectator mode or kick (configurable).

Quality of Life
- Optional keep-inventory rule enforcement.
- Chat and action bar status messages.
- Safe respawn position search around the bed/spawn point.
- Configurable invulnerability window after respawn.

This mod is server-authoritative and suitable for both singleplayer and multiplayer.
